build_nan_detector_context: build a NanDetector context manager to detect NaN or Inf values in a PyTorch model forward pass
create_nan_detector_backward: create a NanDetector instance with backward detection enabled to catch NaN gradients during backpropagation
test_nan_detector_hooks: test the NanDetector forward and backward hooks by running a model forward pass with NaN-producing inputs
review_nan_detector_detect: review the NanDetector _detect method to understand how it checks floating point tensors for NaN or Inf values
refactor_nan_detector_reset: refactor the NanDetector reset method to reinitialize the has_printed_f and has_printed_b tracking flags
